question: Does `maestro-cli send --session` expect the `agentSessionId` (ses_*) value or the `sessionId` (tab UUID) value?

probes.name: fresh-send-mints-session
probes.command: maestro-cli send f35347b5-8d8d-46f6-a50e-79a776dee013 "Reply with exactly the word probe-ok and nothing else." --read-only
probes.observation: The fresh-send envelope carries the new id in the `sessionId` key, and the value is ses_*-shaped (the opencode agent session id), not a tab UUID.

probes.name: resume-with-ses-id-continues-conversation
probes.command: maestro-cli send f35347b5-8d8d-46f6-a50e-79a776dee013 "What exact word did you reply in the previous turn of this session? Reply with only that word." --read-only --session ses_ecf684e0dffehGfsQ9wkmL4Yep
probes.observation: Resuming with the ses_* value continued the conversation (it remembered 'probe-ok') and echoed the same id. The ses_* value is a valid --session id.

probes.name: resume-with-tab-uuid-rejected
probes.command: maestro-cli send f35347b5-8d8d-46f6-a50e-79a776dee013 "Reply with exactly the word probe-ok and nothing else." --read-only --session 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000

captured_stdout.error:
Expected a string starting with "ses"
  at ["sessionID"]

probes.captured_stderr: maestro-cli send failed: Expected a string starting with "ses"
probes.observation: A tab-UUID-shaped id is REJECTED: the CLI validates --session against /^ses/ and names the wire field sessionID. The `sessionId` (tab UUID) value from `session list` is NOT a valid --session id.

probes.name: resume-with-unknown-ses-id-accepted-lazily
probes.command: maestro-cli send f35347b5-8d8d-46f6-a50e-79a776dee013 "Reply with exactly the word probe-ok and nothing else." --read-only --session ses_00000000000000000000000000
probes.observation: A well-formed but nonexistent ses_* id returns success:true with the id echoed; --session performs NO existence check. The only guard against resuming a stale session is the caller's own `session list` membership test.

probes.name: session-list-carries-both-keys
probes.observation: Each `session list` entry carries BOTH keys: `sessionId` == tabId (desktop tab UUID) and `agentSessionId` (ses_* for opencode agents, UUID for other tool types). Only the `agentSessionId` value is accepted by `send --session` (per probe 3). Note: headless `send` turns (probes 1-2) do NOT appear as desktop tabs in this list.

envelope_notes_for_WO_205: The send envelope is a SINGLE JSON object (not a stream): keys agentId, agentName, sessionId, response, success, error, usage.
Under --read-only, `usage` is null; the real usage keys (inputTokens/totalCostUsd) require a non-read-only turn to observe.
